name: clavia-design-system
description: Tokens, ícones, componentes React e Storybook da Clavia.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/tokens build && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/icons build && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/ui build && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/storybook build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm pack:check && pnpm pack:smoke && pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.pack:check: pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/tokens pack:check && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/icons pack:check && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/ui pack:check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/tokens test && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/icons test && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/ui test && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/storybook test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/tokens typecheck && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/icons typecheck && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @clavia-ds/storybook typecheck
